sources.snippet: On 24 March 2025, Alibaba launched Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct as a successor to the Qwen2.5-VL model. It was released under the Apache 2.0 license. sources.snippet: The complexity and opacity of modern model architectures compound this risk. We present the first unified framework and benchmark that not only detects and quantifies positional bias in binary financial decisions but also pinpoints its mechanistic origins within open-source Qwen2.5-instruct models (1.5B-14B).

sources.title: Small Model, Massive Potential: Qwen2.5-1.5B Arrives on the Ascend ...
sources.snippet: The Qwen2.5-1.5B (specifically the libo2024 variant) is a compact, 1.5-billion parameter powerhouse from Alibaba's renowned Qwen family. While the industry often obsesses over massive 70B+ models, this release is designed for developers who need advanced reasoning, coding, and multilingual capabilities at the edge.
